Prompt

Create a real estate agent profile page for an agent named "Sarah Mitchell". Include these sections:

1. HERO/HEADER SECTION
- Professional headshot (large)
- Name: Sarah Mitchell
- Title: Senior Real Estate Agent
- Brokerage name and logo
- License number
- Contact buttons: Call, Email, Text
- Social links: LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook

2. QUICK STATS BAR
- 15+ Years Experience
- 200+ Homes Sold
- $150M+ Total Sales Volume
- 4.9/5 Client Rating (from 120+ reviews)

3. ABOUT ME
- Personal bio (3-4 paragraphs)
- Background and expertise
- Approach to real estate
- Personal interests (humanizing touch)
- Professional photo in different setting

4. AREAS SERVED
- Interactive map highlighting coverage
- List of neighborhoods/cities
- Links to area guides

5. SPECIALIZATIONS
- Luxury Homes
- First-Time Buyers
- Investment Properties
- Relocation Services
- Waterfront Properties
- Visual cards or tags

6. CURRENT LISTINGS
- Grid of active listings (4-6)
- Property photo, price, address, beds/baths
- "View All My Listings" button
- Tab toggle: Active | Pending | Sold

7. RECENTLY SOLD
- Carousel of sold properties
- Sale price and date
- Shows track record

8. CLIENT TESTIMONIALS
- 5-6 detailed reviews
- Client name and photo (if available)
- Property type purchased/sold
- Star ratings
- Date of transaction
- "Read More Reviews" link

9. AWARDS & CERTIFICATIONS
- Top Producer badges
- Certifications: CRS, ABR, SRS, etc.
- Professional association memberships
- Year-over-year achievements

10. CONTACT FORM
- "Let's Connect" header
- Name, email, phone fields
- Interested in: Buying, Selling, Both
- Preferred contact method
- Message textarea
- Expected timeline dropdown
- "Send Message" button

11. OFFICE INFORMATION
- Office address with map
- Office phone
- Hours of availability
- Directions link

Design: Professional, approachable with warm colors. Primary: Deep blue (#2563EB) with warm gray accents. High-quality photos essential. Clean, uncluttered layout. Trust-building elements throughout.
